title: Contract Clause (Silver)
description: Machine-readable twin of phase1_ingestion/data_contract.md. One object per line in output/silver/clauses.jsonl. The prose contract is authoritative for guarantees and limitations; this file is authoritative for shape.

clause_id.description: Primary key. Unique within the dataset.

clause_category.description: Unified from clause_type (v2.1) / category (v2.3) via human-confirmed aliases. OPEN SET - do not switch exhaustively. null means no confirmed alias existed; see _unmapped_fields.

clause_text.description: Verbatim from source. No cleaning or truncation.

section_ref.description: May carry an '(Amended)' marker. Supersession is NOT modelled - see data_contract.md section 3.3.

status.description: OPEN SET. v2.3 introduced 'under_review' with no notice.

last_modified.description: Source system's timestamp, not ours. See _lineage.ingested_at for ours.

modified_by.description: API v2.1 only. null means the source version did not carry the field, NOT that it was empty. Removed in v2.3 and not recoverable.

review_history.description: API v2.3 only. null means the source version did not carry the field - NOT 'never reviewed'.

reviewer.description: Human name. PII - see data_contract.md section 3.5.

_unmapped_fields.description: Source fields present in Bronze with no human-confirmed alias. Non-empty means a schema change is awaiting confirmation in config/schema_aliases.json. This is how the pipeline degrades visibly instead of silently.

_lineage.description: Traceability back to the exact Bronze record. Metadata, not contract data.
